axes.model_access: StepFun’s self-developed Step family has an open-weight line on its Hugging Face organisation page (huggingface.co/stepfun-ai returned 200 on the day). In-product model choice follows the logged-in UI. The official privacy policy treats chat, voice, video calls and task execution as one product surface (2026-11-21).
axes.runtime: Web (chat.stepfun.com, branded “JieYue AI”) plus apps; generation runs in StepFun’s cloud and no model runs locally. The page lists StepClaw and Step Audio Studio (ASR) entry points; open weights are a separate line requiring self-deployment (2026-11-21).
axes.local_files: Chat history syncs on login; uploaded voice, video, images and documents are processed in StepFun’s cloud, and the official privacy summary lists microphone, camera and photo permissions with their scenarios. No model runs locally and no local data surface is listed; downloaded outputs belong to the local machine (2026-11-21).
axes.background: Chat responses return immediately; StepClaw and other agents execute multi-step work in the cloud, and the official privacy policy lists “intelligent dialogue and task execution” as a collection scenario. Official pages provide no user-facing pause, resume or queue panel; long-task state should be checked at the specific entry (2026-11-21).
axes.tools: The page exposes Web Search Tool, knowledge-base Q&A, StepClaw and Step Audio Studio; the official privacy policy names intelligent dialogue and task execution as service scenarios. MCP support is not listed officially and requires wrapping the APIs yourself (2026-11-21).
axes.context: Chat history syncs on login, and the official personal-information list names “historical conversation records” as data used for query and management. Conversation data can be used for training after encryption and de-identification. Cross-session long-term memory and profile entries are not itemised officially (2026-11-21).
axes.permissions: Accounts log in with a StepFun ID; the official privacy summary lists microphone, camera and photo permissions and their scenarios. Conversation data can be used for training after de-identification, and users can manage it through privacy settings and feedback channels; exact switch paths should be checked in-app (2026-11-21).
axes.fit: Fit: a domestic chat product linked to an open-weight ecosystem, with same-vendor HF weights available for local deployment and direct mainland access. Not fit: leaving the StepFun account or running local models inside the chat product (2026-11-21).

runs: This entry checks the chat entry, privacy policy and personal-information list for capability boundaries. StepClaw long tasks, training switches and open-weight deployment need separate measurements.
unknowns:
- Resumption and queue control for StepClaw and other long agent tasks: not listed officially; measure per entry.
- Cross-session long-term memory and profile entries: not itemised officially; check in-product settings.
- Actual model-tier routing inside the chat product: follows the logged-in UI.
related: Also domestic chat linked with open weights: DeepSeek's weights ecosystem is larger, StepFun's product surface is wider (ASR/agent entries).
Also a domestic model-vendor chat entry: Zhipu leans on academic/enterprise lines, StepFun on terminal and multimodal lines.
Another route to "many models": Ollama runs open weights locally, StepFun's weights line also self-deploys via HF.
